signature.one_line: Type-only teaser: typeface swaps every 2-3 frames, accent/black inverting word cards, blurring stock reveal.
unique_devices: Font-swap stutter: one short phrase held for the first third while its typeface hard-swaps every 2-3 frames across ~12 font categories and the text grows continuously
Escalation word cards shown twice each: accent-on-black for 10-13 frames, then the same word black-on-accent for 15-20 frames, identical size and position
First real image only at ~69 % of runtime: stock wide that blurs progressively under a white 2-line question which pops in at 116 % and zooms linearly to ~151 %
signature.why_it_works: The frame changes every few frames without adding words to read; escalating one-word cards build pressure; withholding footage makes the final reveal land.

hook.first_frame: Flat deep-accent card with a small white two-word phrase centred at mid-height in a transitional serif

structure.what: Short vague teaser phrase on accent, typeface swapping every 2-3 frames while it grows ~2.5x
Four comparative one-word cards, each shown twice with accent/black inversion (~8 cards)
Hard cut to a stock wide of the venue type; white 2-line question pops in and zooms while the image blurs

background_text.how: White, one line, centred at 49.6-50.9 % H on flat accent; starts ~40 px (ink 2.19 % H, 23 % W) and grows ~0.8 % scale per frame to ink ~5.4 % H / ~45 % W (wide faces up to 75 % W); whole phrase hard-swaps face every 2-3 frames, never the same face twice in a row

One ALL-CAPS word, heavy flared serif, 129 px Playfair Display 900 stand-in (ink ~5.3 % H, 46-60 % W), centred y ~50 %; each word accent #AF0000 on black 10-13 frames then black on accent 15-20 frames; text and background hard-cut together, no idle motion
White, ALL CAPS with '?', same serif at 87 px, block centred at 50 % H, line gap ~1.6 % H, no box; 1-frame pop (first frame 116 % scale) then linear zoom to ~151 % by the last frame

motion_graphics.what: Continuous phrase growth during font swaps
motion_graphics.how: Linear scale-up ~0.8 %/frame around the frame centre; face swaps are hard (no cross-fade)

cards_lists.how: 4 words x 2 inverted cards = 8 cards in ~114 frames; median card ~16 frames

broll_inserts.what: Single stock wide of the event setting
broll_inserts.how: Full frame, static; Gaussian blur ramps in mostly over 5-29 frames after the cut (ease-out) and keeps softening to ~80 frames after the cut

layout.how: Everything centred at ~50 % H, single words ~45-60 % of W

transitions.how: Every change is an instant text+background swap (detector logs them as soft); no dissolves

transitions.what: Progressive blur on the final shot
transitions.how: Sharp at the cut, heavy blur within ~29 frames, ease-out

end_card.how: No logo, handle or button in the source; brand version may add {{LOGO}} small at the bottom during the last 20 frames

other_text_spec.text: short two-word teaser phrase with full stop (placeholder 'Headline here.'), #FFFFFF, one line, horizontally centred, centre y 49.6-50.9 % of H
other_text_spec.fonts: a different typeface every 2-3 frames, ~12 faces cycling: transitional serif, handwritten pen, light condensed sans, square techno sans, bold condensed caps, rounded marker, bold old-style serif, bold condensed sans, thin condensed small-caps, bubbly hand, wide italic techno sans, heavy humanist sans

closest_match.local: rotate Playfair Display 400 / 400 italic / 900, Inter 300 / 800, Anton 400, Syne 700, Poppins 500, DM Sans 700, JetBrains Mono 500
closest_match.google: add hand faces (Caveat, Permanent Marker, Kalam) and a techno face (Orbitron)

size.growth: each face keeps growing while held (~0.3-0.4 % W per frame, ~0.8 %/frame scale); phrase grows from 23 % to 44-75 % of W over the opener, ink 2.2 % -> 5-8 % of H

animation.swap: hard swap of the whole phrase to the next face every 2-3 frames, same centre
animation.exit: hard cut to the first black word card

other_text_spec.sequence: 4 comparative one-word adjectives, each shown twice: black card (red text) 10-13 frames, then red card (black text) 15-20 frames
other_text_spec.font_class: heavy flared/glyphic serif, all caps: wedge serifs, curled R leg, low contrast

closest_match.google: any flared low-contrast display serif is closer

other_text_spec.fit: Playfair Display 900 @129 px: BIGGER 4.95 % H / 47.8 % W, GRANDER 4.95 % H / 60.6 % W (within tolerance)
other_text_spec.layout: one word, horizontally centred, centre y 49.8-50.1 %

animation.entry: hard cut (text and background change on the same frame)
animation.inversion: same word at identical size/position, colours swapped

other_text_spec.text: 2 centred lines, ALL CAPS, three short words with '?', #FFFFFF (sampled #FDFCF8), same flared serif, block centred at 50.0 % of H, line pitch ~1.36 x cap height (line gap ~1.6 % H), no box, no visible shadow

calibration.line: first line, two short words (~7 characters incl. space)

other_text_spec.fit: Playfair Display 900 @87 px within tolerance; scale to ~131 px (x1.51) by the end

animation.entry: hard cut with a 1-frame pop: first frame ~116 % scale, 100 % from the next frame
animation.idle: continuous linear zoom, ~x1.51 over the remaining ~100 frames

other_text_spec.background: stock wide sharp at the cut; blur ramps in mostly over frames 5-29 after the cut (ease-out) and keeps softening to ~frame 80

style.look_intent: low-contrast, saturated, warm: deep maroon / blood-red / black flat cards, warm golden stock image at the end

sound.music: music-only (beat periodicity 0.33, ~158 bpm estimate); dramatic, building trailer bed (loudness range 7.2 LU)
sfx: none identified (no hard cuts measured on footage)
optional: hit/impact on each colour inversion and a riser under the final zoom

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user wants a short hype teaser or countdown for an event, launch or drop
there is little or no footage (one stock or venue shot is enough)
the message is 'something big is coming' plus a closing question or date
the brand palette has one strong dark colour and one strong accent/accent
avoid_when: the video has a speaker or needs captions
the content needs explanation or proof
viewers sensitive to flashing (inversions every ~15 frames)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B46 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B46.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO speech captions: it is a text-only hype teaser plus one stock/venue shot. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on {{CARD_BG}} and {{CARD_BG}} >= 3:1 on {{ACCENT}}; white text >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}}: opener phrase and closing question, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: word-card colour (text on dark, background on the inverted card), default #AF0000
- {{ACCENT_2}}: unused, default none
- {{SURFACE}}: opener background, default #6C0101 (deep maroon)
- {{CARD_BG}}: dark word-card background, default #000000
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: heavy flared serif for the word cards and question, default Playfair Display 900 (a flared low-contrast display serif is closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: start face of the opener rotation, default Playfair Display 400
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source; optional "@handle" small under the question
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source; optional small logo for the last 20 frames

TITLE CARDS
1. Font-swap opener (first 33 % of runtime, ~106 frames): flat {{SURFACE}}; a short two-word teaser line ("Headline here.") in {{TEXT}}, one line, centred at 50 % H. Every 2-3 frames hard-swap the line to a different typeface category; rotate ~12: Playfair Display 400 / 400 italic / 900, Inter 300 / 800, Anton 400, Syne 700, Poppins 500, DM Sans 700, JetBrains Mono 500, plus Caveat, Permanent Marker, Kalam, Orbitron; never the same face twice in a row. Start at {{FONT_BODY}} 40 px (ink 2.19 % H, width 23.1 % W) and grow continuously (~0.8 % scale per frame) to ink ~5.4 % H / ~45 % W (wide faces up to ~75 % W). No stroke, box or fade.
2. Escalation cards (33-69 % of runtime): 4 one-word ALL-CAPS comparative adjectives in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 129 px ("BIGGER" ink 5.31 % H / 46.5 % W; "GRANDER" 5.23 % / 59.6 %), centred at y 50 %. Each word twice: {{ACCENT}} text on {{CARD_BG}} for 10-13 frames, then {{CARD_BG}} text on {{ACCENT}} for 15-20 frames, identical size and position; text and background hard-cut on the same frame; no idle motion.
3. Closing question (last ~31 %, ~100 frames): hard cut to a full-frame stock or venue wide; 2 centred lines (ALL CAPS, three short words, keep '?'), {{TEXT}}, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 87 px (first line of ~7 characters reads 3.52 % H / 35.4 % W), block centred at 50 % H, line gap ~1.6 % H. Entry: 1-frame pop (first frame 116 % scale, then 100 %), then a linear zoom to ~151 % by the last frame. Background blurs from sharp to heavy mostly over frames 5-29 after the cut (ease-out), softening slightly further to ~frame 80.

OTHER TEXT
4. None in the source. Optional brand sign-off: {{LOGO}} at 8 % W, centred at 88 % H, fades in over 6 frames in the last 20 frames.

SOUND: music only, a building trailer bed; optional impact on each inversion and a riser under the final zoom. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: low-contrast, saturated, warm (deep red / maroon / black cards, golden stock wide).

VERIFY before rendering: render the calibration words and measure them:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_BIGGER_black> --box 0.15,0.45,0.85,0.55 --ink "#AF0000:90"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_GRANDER_red> --box 0.15,0.45,0.85,0.55 --ink "#000000:60"
"BIGGER" must read ink 5.31 % +-0.5 of H and width 46.5 % +-2 of W; "GRANDER" 5.23 % +-0.5 / 59.6 % +-2. Closing question: measure line 1 just after the pop with --box 0.15,0.40,0.85,0.60 --ink "#FFFFFF:45" before the background is bright behind it. For the brand's own words compute the expected ink with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py at 129 px / 87 px in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} (swap the --ink colour to {{ACCENT}} / {{CARD_BG}} when the tokens change). Positions within +-1 % of frame height.
